LanguageData.RB_Rec1: Colonists pick bills on a bench at random, the top ones a bit more often.
LanguageData.RB_Rec2: A mode button on every bench: weighted, random or in order.
LanguageData.RB_Enabled_Desc: Master switch for the whole mod.
LanguageData.RB_TopWeight_Desc: How much more often the bills at the top are picked in the weighted mode. 0 % = like random, 100 % = the top ones clearly more often (but the lower ones still get done).
LanguageData.RB_ShowGizmo_Desc: Every bench gets a button to switch its own mode.
LanguageData.RB_Gizmo_Desc:
How a colonist picks the next bill on this bench. Click to change.

Weighted – at random, the top bills a bit more often.
Random – every bill the same chance.
In order – like the game: the first one that can be done.

A bill must still be possible (ingredients, skill, 'do X times' not finished). Work already started is finished first.
LanguageData.RB_AvoidRepeat_Desc: The bill a colonist just did gets a smaller chance next time – also 'do X times' bills, so the others get their turn between the pieces.
